title: TaiwanICDF International Higher Education Scholarship Program
field: Degree programmes at partner universities in Taiwan
about: TaiwanICDF scholarships fund international students in degree programmes at partner universities in Taiwan. The 2027 online application, covering the TaiwanICDF Scholarship and the Taiwan-Europe Scholarship, runs from 1 December 2026 to 15 March 2027.
requirements: Online application covers both the TaiwanICDF Scholarship and the Taiwan-Europe Scholarship
Documents are also submitted through the ROC (Taiwan) embassy or representative office in the applicant's country
Incomplete or inaccurate applications are not processed
card_alt: EduCut Connect card for the TaiwanICDF International Higher Education Scholarship Program from the International Cooperation and Development Fund (TaiwanICDF), Taiwan, deadline 15 Mar 2027.
